title: HtmlMenu
responsibility: Renders the native menu element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlMenu.attributes
inputs.description: Native menu attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlMenu.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native menu element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlMenu
outputs.description: The actual native menu element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
